verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own review step: change requests require an approval before changes land in an environment, and they can group changes and apply them at a set time. Its rollout automations can also pause or disable themselves via safeguards, which is a rollback of the rollout, not of the automation's configuration. There is no evidence of versioning or history for automations such as release templates, nor of restoring a prior automation version. missing for 10: version history for automations/release templates, explicit rollback to a previous automation config, evidence that change requests cover automation definitions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.
Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
Automate milestone progression or trigger safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold.
